name: number-roll
title: Number roll
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Rolls an integer and its fraction separately, using only transform and opacity.

meta.descriptionEs: Rueda el entero y los decimales por separado, solo con transform y opacidad.

examples.title: Rodillo numérico
examples.description: Rueda el entero y los decimales por separado, solo con transform y opacidad.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320 px, vacío, negativo, RTL y 60 caracteres.

api.name: value
api.description: The figure to show. Non-finite values render as zero.

api.name: locale
api.description: BCP 47 locale. es-MX and en-US format the catalog pair.

api.name: prefix / suffix
api.description: Static text beside the reel. They do not roll.

api.name: hierarchy
api.description: Draw the fraction smaller and lighter than the integer.

api.name: announce
api.description: Expose the formatted value to assistive tech. Default true.

api.name: className / classNames
api.description: Root class and slot classes for integer, fraction, prefix, and suffix.

docs: Clean-room. Integer versus fraction and the continuity of the roll follow a public description of Jakub Antalik's Transitions UI (https://x.com/jakubantalik/status/2115844862012768541). That product is not open source; no source, sample data, icons, or assets were copied. See docs/layout-transitions.md and NOTICE. The reel uses only transform and opacity, and settles immediately when the reader prefers reduced motion. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
